title: Securities Research Modernization Act
committees: H-Financial Services Committee: Referred To 2025-06-02 -> Markup By 2025-06-10 -> Reported By 2025-07-15
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 167.
summary: Securities Research Modernization Act This bill allows a securities broker or dealer to publish or distribute a research report on a proposed public offering by any issuer without it being considered an offer to sell securities for purposes of registration requirements. Currently, only reports published or distributed regarding a proposed public offering by an emerging growth company fall under this exception.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
